items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: And then I got a fellow by the name of Joe Johnson. He used to play trumpet too. ... Joe Johnson. No, no, he used to write music for us.

ctx.x: Alvin, Alvin. Yeah, well I saw him Sunday. Well I sent the boy, my boy, he was going to school again in Yardins. I sent him to get the boy and we were playing a big job at the community club. Someone will see him tomorrow night. I'll tell him hello for you. Yeah? And when he came out and I told the boy, my boy, I said, boy what you brought that boy out here for? I said, that boy can't play. So I said, boy you want to try the music? He said, no, never mind. And I said, well tonight I'm stuck because I had boys…
What did he play like? Was he an ear man too? Who that?
